clinics.name: Thames Valley Family Health Team (TVFHT)
clinics.evidence_quote: Thames Valley Family Health Team (TVFHT) is currently accepting new patients for our nurse practitioner clinics in London, Middlesex, Elgin, and Oxford.
clinics.raw_notes: Clinic is accepting new patients for nurse practitioner clinics in London, Middlesex, Elgin, and Oxford. Registration requires: (1) name, (2) Ontario health care number, and (3) contact information (phone number, email address, mailing address). Contact via the contact form on the page or call 519-473-0530 ext. 2197 (business hours: Mon-Fri, 8am-4pm). Family can also be registered. Note: patients who already have a family doctor in the area may also be accepted locally.
